newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said early-maturing contracts of one-month and less were active with the market expecting the central bank to cut bank reserve ratios before the end of this year.

"Borrowing is focused on shorter-term contracts on uncertainty before the central bank cut bank reserve ratios," said one trader. "Securities houses and brokerages are net borrowers with (domestic) A share markets active recently."
The People's Bank of China in July said it would cut bank reserve ratios shortly with inflation falling, and most investors believe the cut will be before the end of this year.
Traders expect the rates to move narrowly before the cut.
